notes: From the Lost Woods exit at (-7, 74) to the gate (Obj_SacredForest_SwitchShutter_A_02) at (-7.1, 49.1). Child: a Wolfos at (-7.1, 52.4) with an enemy counter; beating it opens the gate (event SacredForestMeadow_Gimmick_OpenShutter). The adult map has the gate but no Wolfos or counter: assumed open for adult, check in game. Grotto hole at (-1.6, 51.2) under a Song of Storms cover (Land_Kokiri_HidingHoleCover_A_01, built on Land_HidingHoleCover_DisappearSrom_Base): in the N64 game this grotto was opened with explosives. Pierre's scarecrow spot (adult) at (-11.1, 48.1).

The maze from the gate up to the stairs (z about -65). Child: Mad Scrubs; adult: five Moblins and the club Moblin guarding the stairs (at (-6.9, -59.8), or (-6.9, -32.8) once moved). As in the N64 logic, nothing is needed to get past them. Fairy fountain grotto at (-4.2, 1.9), open, no item check.

SFM GS.note: adult map only, on a wall about 7 units up; not night-only (the N64 one was): reach to check in game

SFM Maze Gossip Stone Lower.note: hint stone, not an item check (GOSSIP_SACRED_FOREST_MEADOW_02), just past the gate

SFM Maze Gossip Stone Upper.note: hint stone, not an item check (GOSSIP_SACRED_FOREST_MEADOW_01)

notes: The top of the stairs (y about 114): Saria's stump at (-2.2, -101.1), the Minuet of Forest warp pad at (-6.9, -96.0), the Forest Temple entrance up at (-7, 119.2, -116.9) with a hookshot target above it at (-6.9, 123.7, -115.2). The child map has an invisible wall in front of the temple entrance. Grotto hole at (1.3, -85.5) under a bomb cover (Land_SacredForest_HidingHoleCover_A_02, built on Land_HidingHoleCover_BrokenBomb_Base): in the N64 game this was the Song of Storms grotto.

Song from Saria.note: Saria's Song (event SacredForestMeadow_Field_MelodyGet_Saria). The N64 rule (Zelda's letter); the remake's condition is still to be found

Sheik in Forest.note: Minuet of Forest (event ForestTemple_SageOfForest_MelodyGet). The N64 rule; the remake's condition is still to be found

SFM Saria Gossip Stone.note: hint stone, not an item check (GOSSIP_SACRED_FOREST_MEADOW_03)

notes: Underground (y about 82) below the entryway hole. Two Wolfos; beating them makes the chest appear (event SacredForestMeadow_Gimmick_TreasureChestAppears).

Underground (y about 96) below the upper hole. Not the N64 storms grotto (two Deku Scrubs): the remake puts a chest, a gossip stone and the Song of Time block tutorial here (Obj_SongOfTimeSign_A_01, event SacredForest_FirstTimeBLock). The blocks at (5-7, -80 to -82) stand between the landing at (1.3, -85.5) and the chest at (12.1, -73.8): check in game that they really cut it off.

SFM Upper Grotto Gossip Stone.note: hint stone, not an item check; the game names it GOSSIP_KOKIRI_FOREST_02 although it is in this map
